metadata.title: Bevacizumab 7.5 mg/kg – 21 days
metadata.indication: Metastatic colorectal cancer with fluoropyrimidine chemotherapy; first-line non-squamous advanced/recurrent NSCLC with platinum chemotherapy, then permitted bevacizumab continuation. Component assessment only.
metadata.partial_assessment_note: Any independently actionable entered value is assessed; omitted domains remain unassessed and do not block a partial result.
metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Organ-function values or categories are optional; omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

metadata.patient_scope: This pack is for NCCP 00214 b lung treatment and the bevacizumab component only. It does not replace the partner chemotherapy pack or describe colorectal treatment.
metadata.source_retrieval_method: Official HSE PDF downloaded 2026-11-02; tabular pages rendered and visually inspected
metadata.schedule_summary: Bevacizumab is given by drip on Day 1 every 21 days. In this lung setting it starts with platinum chemotherapy for up to 6 cycles, then may continue alone while helping and tolerable. Your team must supply the partner chemotherapy schedule.

clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding derived from NCCP 00214 Version 8. It does not replace the current official regimen, prescribing review, pharmacy verification or independent clinical judgement.

indications.description: With fluoropyrimidine-based chemotherapy for adults with metastatic carcinoma of the colon or rectum.
With platinum-based chemotherapy for first-line unresectable advanced, metastatic or recurrent NSCLC other than predominantly squamous histology.

treatment.schedule_summary: Bevacizumab 7.5 mg/kg IV Day 1 every 21 days; colorectal with fluoropyrimidine chemotherapy until progression/toxicity; lung with platinum chemotherapy for up to six cycles then bevacizumab continuation.

action.recommendation: Complete assessment and prescribing review of every partner SACT medicine; this assessment evaluates bevacizumab only.

action.recommendation: Review the specific bleeding, clotting, cardiovascular, renal/proteinuria, radiotherapy, fistula or perforation risk before treatment. A caution is not automatically an absolute exclusion. Include aneurysm/dissection history and intra-abdominal inflammation.

rules.explanation: Concurrent sunitinib increases risk of microangiopathic haemolytic anaemia; review and avoid an unassessed combination.

action.recommendation: Do not administer panitumumab or cetuximab with bevacizumab-containing chemotherapy for metastatic colorectal cancer. Review and correct the entire combination with the consultant; this component assessment does not independently prescribe the partner regimen.

action.recommendation: Withhold bevacizumab for recent major surgery or an unhealed wound: at least 28 days after major surgery AND full wound healing are required before starting; review any treatment-emergent wound complication.

rules.explanation: Withhold bevacizumab for recent major surgery or an unhealed wound: at least 28 days after major surgery AND full wound healing are required before starting; review any treatment-emergent wound complication.

action.recommendation: Do not initiate bevacizumab within 28 days after major surgery; at least 28 days AND full wound healing are required.

rules.explanation: Do not initiate bevacizumab within 28 days after major surgery; at least 28 days AND full wound healing are required.

action.recommendation: Withhold bevacizumab until the surgical wound is fully healed, even if the 28-day interval has elapsed.

rules.explanation: Withhold bevacizumab until the surgical wound is fully healed, even if the 28-day interval has elapsed.

action.recommendation: Withhold for elective major surgery for 28 days or according to the prescribing consultant plan; agree timing and wound reassessment.

rules.explanation: Withhold for elective major surgery for 28 days or according to the prescribing consultant plan; agree timing and wound reassessment.

action.recommendation: Withhold for minor surgery for 7 days or according to the prescribing consultant plan; agree timing and wound reassessment.

rules.explanation: Withhold for minor surgery for 7 days or according to the prescribing consultant plan; agree timing and wound reassessment.

action.recommendation: Withhold bevacizumab for uncontrolled or symptomatic hypertension; start or adjust antihypertensive treatment.

rules.explanation: Withhold bevacizumab for uncontrolled or symptomatic hypertension; start or adjust antihypertensive treatment.

action.recommendation: Discontinue bevacizumab for persisting grade 3 hypertension.

rules.explanation: Discontinue bevacizumab for persisting grade 3 hypertension.

action.recommendation: Discontinue bevacizumab for grade 4 hypertension.

rules.explanation: Discontinue bevacizumab for grade 4 hypertension.

action.recommendation: Start or optimise antihypertensive therapy. Assess control, symptoms and persistence; uncontrolled or symptomatic hypertension requires withholding. Grade 3 alone does not establish persistence; persisting grade 3 or grade 4 requires discontinuation.

rules.explanation: Start or optimise antihypertensive therapy. Assess control, symptoms and persistence; uncontrolled or symptomatic hypertension requires withholding. Grade 3 alone does not establish persistence; persisting grade 3 or grade 4 requires discontinuation.

action.recommendation: Discontinue bevacizumab for clinically confirmed severe BP >200/110 mmHg that remains uncontrolled with medication.

rules.explanation: Discontinue bevacizumab for clinically confirmed severe BP >200/110 mmHg that remains uncontrolled with medication.

action.recommendation: Permanently discontinue bevacizumab and manage hypertensive crisis or encephalopathy urgently.

rules.explanation: Permanently discontinue bevacizumab and manage hypertensive crisis or encephalopathy urgently.

action.recommendation: For the proteinuria domain only, a 2+/3+ dipstick permits scheduled bevacizumab while collecting a 24-hour urine total protein within 3 days before the next dose. Apply any quantified result and all other safety findings.

rules.explanation: For the proteinuria domain only, a 2+/3+ dipstick permits scheduled bevacizumab while collecting a 24-hour urine total protein within 3 days before the next dose. Apply any quantified result and all other safety findings.

action.recommendation: For the proteinuria domain only, spot urine protein ≥1 g/L requires a 24-hour total protein collection within 3 days before the next dose; the source permits the scheduled dose if no other hold criterion applies. g/L is not g/24 h.

rules.explanation: For the proteinuria domain only, spot urine protein ≥1 g/L requires a 24-hour total protein collection within 3 days before the next dose; the source permits the scheduled dose if no other hold criterion applies. g/L is not g/24 h.

action.recommendation: Withhold bevacizumab for 4+ dipstick pending 24-hour urine total protein; subsequently apply the quantified result.

rules.explanation: Withhold bevacizumab for 4+ dipstick pending 24-hour urine total protein; subsequently apply the quantified result.

action.recommendation: Quantified protein ≤2 g/24 h permits treatment in the proteinuria domain only, subject to nephrotic syndrome/grade 4 proteinuria and all other findings. Omitted domains remain unassessed.

rules.explanation: Quantified protein ≤2 g/24 h permits treatment in the proteinuria domain only, subject to nephrotic syndrome/grade 4 proteinuria and all other findings. Omitted domains remain unassessed.

action.recommendation: Hold bevacizumab for urine total protein >2 to 4 g/24 h; recheck every 2 weeks and resume only when ≤2 g/24 h with consultant review of all other domains.

action.recommendation: Discontinue bevacizumab for urine total protein >4 g/24 h.

rules.explanation: Discontinue bevacizumab for urine total protein >4 g/24 h.

action.recommendation: Discontinue bevacizumab for grade 4 proteinuria irrespective of a lower current measured protein value; nephrotic syndrome requires permanent discontinuation.

rules.explanation: Discontinue bevacizumab for grade 4 proteinuria irrespective of a lower current measured protein value; nephrotic syndrome requires permanent discontinuation.

action.recommendation: Permanently discontinue bevacizumab for nephrotic syndrome, regardless of a lower subsequent protein result.

action.recommendation: Discontinue bevacizumab for any grade 4 fistula.

rules.explanation: Discontinue bevacizumab for any grade 4 fistula.

rules.explanation: Discontinue bevacizumab for tracheoesophageal fistula of any grade.

action.recommendation: Stop the infusion immediately and provide appropriate urgent medical treatment. Rechallenge or permanent stopping requires specialist review of the reaction.

action.recommendation: Review the blood-count abnormality and companion chemotherapy separately. NCCP 00214 does not provide cycle-by-cycle bevacizumab numerical dose reductions; initial eligibility thresholds are separate and are not invented cycle-by-cycle holds.

action.recommendation: Confirm the selected indication and consultant continuation plan. NCCP 00214 b permits bevacizumab alone after up to six platinum-combination cycles; 00214 a specifies use with fluoropyrimidine chemotherapy. No automatic phase switch.

Review repeated BP, symptoms and control; a numerical entry alone is not converted into a definitive hold. Uncontrolled or symptomatic hypertension requires withholding.

action.recommendation: Age over65 increases arterial thromboembolism risk with bevacizumab plus chemotherapy. Review vascular risk and treatment suitability; age alone is not an exclusion.

rules.explanation: Age over65 increases arterial thromboembolism risk with bevacizumab plus chemotherapy. Review vascular risk and treatment suitability; age alone is not an exclusion.

eligibility: Initial eligibility: ANC ≥1.2, platelets >100 ×10⁹/L; creatinine ≤1.5 ×ULN; bilirubin ≤26 µmol/L; AST and ALP ≤5 ×ULN. These are initial eligibility, not source-defined automatic ongoing dose reductions.
exclusions: Known hypersensitivity to a regimen component
Pregnancy or breastfeeding where prohibited by the current source
monitoring: Baseline FBC, renal/liver profile, urine protein, BP and cardiac history/examination. Consider ECHO after chest-wall radiation or anthracyclines.
Regular FBC, renal/liver profile and urine protein; BP before each cycle and post-treatment.
If taking warfarin, weekly INR until stable dose then before each cycle. Disease monitoring follows the consultant plan.
dose_modifications: No adverse-event dose reductions: suspend or discontinue as source directs.
Proteinuria dipstick/spot concentration and24-hour total protein are separate measurements; use Table2 exact thresholds.
No validated renal or hepatic impairment adjustment is supplied; review suitability and partner drugs separately.

supportive_care.mapping_basis: Bevacizumab component only: minimal emetogenic risk. Any chemotherapy partner needs its own risk assessment and prescription.

treatment_phases.label: Colorectal bevacizumab component
treatment_phases.duration_text: With fluoropyrimidine-based chemotherapy until progression or unacceptable toxicity.
treatment_phases.schedule_summary: With fluoropyrimidine-based chemotherapy until progression or unacceptable toxicity.

administration.notes: Infuse in 100 mL sodium chloride 0.9% over 90 minutes initially, then 60 and 30 minutes if preceding infusions tolerated. Do not mix with glucose or give as IV bolus. Companion medicines require separate assessment.
